title: Graphene-silver hybrid nanoparticle embedded phase change materials for enhanced thermal management of lithium-ion batteries
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,16564-16585
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09895E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Balan Akshay, Faisal Seyas Seyas Mumthas, Manu Mohan, Vishnu Bhuvanachandran Rajeswari, C. Ravikumar
Silver-bridged graphene reconfigures phase change material pathways, shifting transport from conduction to convection-enhanced regimes. This ensures rapid thermal buffering and metrological safety for high-power lithium-ion battery modules.
